podcast.title: Evolution from Early Phonk
podcast.body: Rare Phonk emerged as a lighter evolution from the "oppressive and terrifying darkness" of early Phonk. Pioneers like DJ Smokey, DJ Jung Bump, and collectives such as Jolimopo por Pell Pose shifted towards a more "chill" approach, embracing psychedelia, and incorporating references to the internet, video games, marijuana, and anime. "Poco a poco la oscuridad impresiva y terrorífica, empezamos a dejar paso a un enfoque más ligero, dando lugar al rar Funk."
